File created: `/vercel/sandbox/middleware.ts`

The middleware has been created with the following functionality:
1. Logs the request pathname to the console
2. Generates a unique request ID using `crypto.randomUUID()`
3. Adds the `X-Request-Id` header to all responses

Make sure to:
1. Place this file in your Next.js project's root directory or `src` directory
2. The middleware will automatically apply to all routes in your application
